verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into dLocal's dashboard or platform. The docs only link out to external assistants (ChatGPT and Claude) to explain documentation pages, and the MCP server lets outside agents connect to dLocal. Both are adjacent capabilities, not an in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
